scene_description: Dark cabinet top with raised side and rear panels beside white and orange walls. A yellow pencil and metal paper clip lie on the left near a white instruction manual topped by a black remote. An upright paper towel roll, blue spray bottle, and gray eraser occupy the right side, leaving a broad open central area. Three photographs show the arrangement from different viewpoints.

targets.name: yellow pencil
targets.description: Yellow wooden pencil with a pink eraser lying along the left side of the cabinet top, beside the paper clip and to the left of the instruction manual.
targets.orientation: lying flat, roughly parallel to the left side panel
targets.clearance_notes: Pencil is close to the raised left panel, restricting approach from that side. Its upper surface and side facing the cabinet center are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the pencil away from the raised left panel into the clear central area to expose both sides.

targets.name: gray eraser
targets.description: Rectangular gray whiteboard eraser lying near the front-right of the cabinet top, in front of the blue spray bottle.
nearby_obstacles: Blue spray bottle behind the eraser
targets.clearance_notes: Top and front face are exposed with visible space around the eraser. It is separated from the spray bottle and can be approached from the open center and front.
targets.other_notes: No obvious environmental adjustment is needed for access.

targets.name: blue spray bottle
targets.description: Blue cylindrical spray bottle with a white pump and white-green label, standing in front of the paper towel roll and behind the gray eraser on the right side of the cabinet top.
nearby_obstacles: Paper towel roll immediately behind the bottle
targets.clearance_notes: Front and upper portions are exposed. The paper towel roll restricts clearance behind the bottle; the eraser occupies some space ahead of its base.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the bottle into the open central area, leaving space between it, the paper towel roll, and the eraser.
Move the paper towel roll farther left into the open central area to increase space behind and beside the spray bottle while leaving the bottle upright in place.

targets.other_notes: contents and fill level are unknown.

targets.name: black remote
targets.description: Black LG remote control with colored buttons resting button-side up on the white instruction manual on the left side of the cabinet top.
nearby_obstacles: Raised rear panel near the far end
targets.clearance_notes: Buttons and long side edges are exposed. The manual is underneath rather than covering the remote; the remote can be accessed from above and the open center side.
targets.other_notes: No obvious environmental adjustment is needed to access the remote itself.

targets.name: white instruction manual
targets.description: White instruction booklet with a stethoscope illustration, lying beneath the black remote to the right of the yellow pencil.
nearby_obstacles: Black remote resting on the manual
Raised left and rear panels nearby
targets.clearance_notes: The remote covers and loads part of the booklet. Some paper edges remain exposed, but moving the booklet independently could disturb the remote.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the remote onto a clear part of the cabinet top before picking up the instruction manual.

targets.other_notes: Height of null reflects the thinness of the booklet; it does not mean physically zero thickness.

targets.name: metal paper clip
targets.description: Large silver wire paper clip lying next to the yellow pencil, on the side facing the cabinet center and to the left of the instruction manual.
targets.clearance_notes: Wire is exposed from above but lies flush against the surface. The pencil and left panel reduce space on one side.

candidate_improvements.description: Separate the paper clip from the pencil by moving it into the open central area.

targets.other_notes: Width is the short axis and depth the long axis. Height of 0 is retained as a rounded thin-object approximation, not literal zero thickness. The separate small metal item by the manual is not this target.

targets.name: paper towel roll
targets.description: Upright white paper towel roll with an exposed cardboard core, positioned toward the rear-right of the cabinet top behind the blue spray bottle.
nearby_obstacles: Blue spray bottle immediately in front
targets.clearance_notes: Top and left side are exposed. The spray bottle blocks part of the lower front approach, while the surrounding panels limit low approaches from the rear and right.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the spray bottle into the clear central area to expose the front of the paper towel roll.
Move the upright paper towel roll left into the clear central area, separating it from the spray bottle and right side panel.

targets.other_notes: Width and depth represent outer diameter. Physical blockage is partial and approach-dependent; the roll is accessible from above.

source: User-provided scene photographs and object dimensions. Targets restricted to the user-listed objects, with two unlabeled dimension entries interpreted as the paper clip and paper towel roll.
